summary: read_bytes(path, infer=False, gpg=None, gzip=None) — one-liner that reads bytes from any recognised URL scheme. Infers the provider from the path scheme, constructs a transient StorageFacade, and returns raw bytes. Supports infer=True for suffix-based pipeline inference. Works with s3://, gs://, https://, /local/paths, and any other registered scheme.
lifecycle_notes: Does not cache the facade; each call creates a transient connection
documentation_hooks: read_bytes is the simplest entry point for users who just want bytes from any path
Document that auth_params are not supported via read_bytes — use StorageFacade for authenticated backends
risks: No auth_params support — read_bytes only works for unauthenticated or implicitly-credentialed backends
open_questions: Should read_bytes accept auth_params for authenticated paths?
